title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jets D/ST struggles in Week 7 loss
items.desc: The Jets D/ST allowed 208 passing yards, 156 rushing yards, and 28 points in a Week 7 loss to Miami.
items.impact: The Jets' defense tallied two sacks but failed to force a turnover. The defense was unable to stop Malik Willis and Ollie Gordon in either phase of the game. The Dolphins will take on the Raiders in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jason Sanders misses a field goal in Week 7
items.desc: Jason Sanders connected on 1-of-2 field goals and 2-of-2 extra points in a 28-25 loss to Miami.
items.impact: Sanders missed a 40-yard field goal to open the third quarter, marking his first miss of the season. Sanders will look to bounce back against the Raiders in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mason Taylor hits pay dirt twice in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Mason Taylor caught 5-of-6 targets for 62 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
items.impact: Taylor has seen six targets in back-to-back games for the Jets and accounted for two of the team's three touchdowns Sunday. Taylor appears to be more trusted than Kenyon Sadiq by Geno Smith, leaving Taylor as the better option heading into Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq held to one reception in Week 7
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq caught his lone target for six yards in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
items.impact: Sadiq has struggled to get involved over the past few weeks. He saw Mason Taylor score twice for the Jets Sunday, leaving Sadiq as a risky option heading into Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Adonai Mitchell held without a reception in Week 7
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell did not record a reception on three targets in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
items.impact: Mitchell was held without a catch in his return from a finger injury. He was overshadowed by an excellent performance from Omar Cooper. Fantasy managers can leave Mitchell out of their lineups in Week 8.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: George Kittle leads 49ers in receiving Sunday
items.desc: George Kittle hauled in 8-of-10 targets for 88 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: With both Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel out, Kittle put up new season highs in receptions, targets, and receiving yards on Sunday. The veteran TE is averaging just under five grabs for more than 60 yards per game with five touchdowns through seven weeks. Kittle remains among the top fantasy assets at TE.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 5-of-5 targets for 115 yards and a touchdown in the Jets' 28-25 loss to Miami.
items.impact: Cooper has put together back-to-back 100 yard performances for the Jets. He did the bulk of his work on receptions of 52 and 60-yards. Fantasy managers should view him as a strong option heading into a Week 8 matchup with the Raiders.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Garrett Wilson quiet in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Garrett Wilson caught 2-of-3 targets for 26 yards in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
items.impact: Wilson turned in his worst performance of the season Sunday, with the star receiver not seeing a target until the second half. Wilson will look to bounce back against Las Vegas in Week 8.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk catches TD pass in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk caught all three of his targets for 11 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: With the 49ers WR corps beat up, Juszczyk was targeted a season-high three times on Sunday and caught his second touchdown of the campaign. Juszczyk has long been a valuable contributor for the 49ers, but he simply doesn't carry much fantasy value.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Isaiah Davis sees four touches in Week 7
items.desc: Isaiah Davis rushed for five yards on one carry in the Jets' 28-25 loss to Miami. He caught 3-of-3 targets for 49 yards.
items.impact: Davis was not really involved in the offense Sunday, with Braelon Allen seeing the bulk of the work out of the Jets' backfield. Davis can stay off the fantasy radar heading into Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Braelon Allen eclipses 100 rushing yards in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Braelon Allen rushed for 104 yards on 17 carries in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins. He caught 6-of-7 targets for 30 yards.
items.impact: Allen was heavily involved in both phases of the offense, with his seven targets and six receptions leading the pass catchers for the Jets. Allen has potentially carved out a role for himself even if Breece Hall is able to return to the field in Week 8.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jordan Watkins eclipses 50 yards receiving Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Watkins caught 3-of-6 targets for 56 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: With both Deebo Samuel and Mike Evans sidelined, Jordan Watkins led the way for 49ers'wide receivers on Sunday. The second-year pro is not likely to make much of a fantasy impact after the Week 8 bye.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Geno Smith tosses three touchdowns in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Geno Smith completed 23-of-30 passes for 287 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in a 28-25 loss to Miami.
items.impact: Smith and the Jets trailed the Dolphins, allowing for a high volume passing attack in the final three quarters. Smith connected with Mason Taylor twice and Omar Cooper for his three touchdown passes. Smith and the Jets will take on the Raiders in Week 8.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Christian McCaffrey gains 100 yards, scores in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey rushed for 39 yards and a touchdown on seven carries, adding six receptions for 61 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: McCaffrey dealt with a thigh injury for a portion of Sunday's game, but he still ended up gaining 100 yards of offense on 13 touches. He also found the end zone on the ground for the eighth time this season. He remains a top-shelf fantasy option.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Dolphins D/ST allows 25 points in Week 7 win
items.desc: The Dolphins D/ST allowed 25 points, 287 passing yards, and 108 rushing yards in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
items.impact: The Dolphins' defense tallied two sacks and one interception on their way to their first win of the season. The Dolphins' defense will face a tougher test in Week 8 against Drake Maye and the Patriots.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Zane Gonzalez perfect in Week 7 win
items.desc: Zane Gonzalez connected on 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Gonzalez was elevated from the Dolphins' practice squad and performed well in his first game of the season. The Dolphins will likely elevate him again in Week 8 to kick against New England.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Greg Dulcich hauls in five passes in Week 7 win
items.desc: Greg Dulcich caught 5-of-5 targets for 86 yards in the Dolphins' 28-25 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Dulcich led the team in receptions, targets, and receiving yards Sunday. The veteran tight end should remain a key component in the Dolphins' offense in Week 8 against New England.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kaelon Black finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Kaelon Black rushed for 63 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: Black led the 49ers in carries Sunday afternoon and gashed the Falcons' defense for a 30-yard TD run in the second quarter. Christian McCaffrey did deal with a thigh issue in this one and ended up only outtouching Black 13-to-12. This was a nice game for Black, but he remains useful to fantasy managers only as a handcuff to McCaffrey.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chris Bell hauls in three passes in Week 7
items.desc: Chris Bell caught 3-of-4 targets for 25 yards in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Bell caught his first pass since Week 3, but was not heavily featured in the Dolphins' passing attack. Fantasy managers should look elsewhere for wide receiver production for now.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Caleb Douglas finds the end zone twice in Week 7
items.desc: Caleb Douglas caught 2-of-3 targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Douglas found the end zone on a seven yard reception and a 63-yard reception to help pace the Dolphins to their first win of the season. This marked the first game Douglas has played in since suffering an injury in Week 2, and he provided an immediate jolt in the Dolphins' passing attack. Douglas will look to build on this performance against the Patriots in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Malik Washington hauls in three passes in Week 7 win
items.desc: Malik Washington caught 3-of-3 targets for 27 yards in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He rushed for eight yards on two carries.
items.impact: Washington's three targets are his lowest of the season, which comes on the heels the return of Caleb Douglas to the lineup. Washington will look to bounce back in Week 8 against New England.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jaylen Wright (quad) exits early Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (quad) rushed for eight yards on six carries in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He did not record a catch on his lone target.
items.impact: Wright left the game in the fourth quarter with a quad injury and did not return. Ollie Gordon would be in line for another large workload in Week 8 if Wright is unable to play.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ollie Gordon II finds the end zone in Week 7 win
items.desc: Ollie Gordon II rushed for 103 yards and a touchdown on 23 carries in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He caught 1-of-3 targets for no yards.
items.impact: Gordon has scored in four straight games and tallied 80+ rushing yards in three straight contests. Jaylen Wright exited the game with a quad injury, which could to Gordon seeing plenty of work again in Week 8 if Wright is unable to play against New England.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Malik Willis tallies three touchdowns in Week 7 win
items.desc: Malik Willis completed 14-of-21 passes for 208 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He rushed for 37 yards and a touchdown on eight carries.
items.impact: Willis found Caleb Douglas for both of his touchdowns Sunday to propel the Dolphins to their first win of the season. Willis and the Dolphins will look to build on their success in a Week 8 matchup against New England.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ravens D/ST allows 35 second half points in Week 7 loss
items.desc: The Ravens D/ST allowed 292 passing yards, 73 rushing yards, and 35 points in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied one sack but failed to force a turnover in a loss to the Bengals. The Ravens' defense will face a tough matchup with Josh Allen and the Bills on the schedule for Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyler Loop perfect in Week 7
items.desc: Tyler Loop connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 1-of-1 extra point in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: Loop connected on field goals from 24 and 34 yards out to provide the Ravens a 13-0 halftime lead. The second-year kicker could be a stronger option for fantasy managers with the return of Lamar Jackson expected in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mark Andrews hauls in three passes in Week 7
items.desc: Mark Andrews caught 3-of-4 targets for 23 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: Andrews led the tight end group in targets and receptions in the loss to the Bengals. Andrews has not seen the same target share with Tyler Huntley at quarterback, so it would be a welcome sight for fantasy managers if Lamar Jackson is able to play in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rashod Bateman hauls in two passes in Week 7
items.desc: Rashod Bateman caught 2-of-4 targets for 33 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: Bateman has seen his role decrease over the last two weeks with the return of Ja'Kobi Lane to the lineup. Bateman is a bench stash at best right now for fantasy managers heading into a Week 8 matchup with the Bills.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane hauls in three passes in Week 7
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: Lane has logged five targets in two straight games since returning from injury.  Fantasy managers should expect the rookie to continue to get plenty of opportunities in the Ravens' passing attack.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Zay Flowers excellent in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Zay Flowers caught 8-of-11 targets for 137 yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
items.impact: Flowers opened the scoring on a 48-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Flowers led the team in all receiving categories, and he will look to do the same in Week 8 against the Bills.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Justice Hill sees six touches in Week 7
items.desc: Justice Hill rushed for seven yards on three carries in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 26 yards.
items.impact: Hill continues to work in the passing game, with the majority of his snaps coming as the Ravens' were attempt a comeback. Fantasy managers can leave Hill off their radar for now.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Derrick Henry quiet in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Derrick Henry rushed for 45 yards on 17 carries in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals. He caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards.
items.impact: The Bengals' defense was able to bottle up Henry all day, leading to his worst performance of the season. The Ravens are hopeful to have Lamar Jackson back in Week 8, which could open up more lanes for Henry against Buffalo.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Brock Purdy throws for 288 yards, two picks in Sunday's loss
items.desc: Brock Purdy completed 27 of 40 passes for 288 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: Purdy threw just two interceptions over the first six games of the season. He doubled that total Sunday, including one late in the fourth quarter during a comeback attempt by the 49ers. Purdy had the yardage and found the end zone once in this one, but it was ultimately a game Purdy would probably like to forget. He's still having an excellent season going into the 49ers' bye.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyler Huntley solid in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Tyler Huntley completed 23-of-34 passes for 298 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals. He added 12 rushing yards on three carries.
items.impact: Huntley's 298 passing yards set a new season high and the Ravens' backup was able to be efficient throughout the game. The Ravens' rushing attack could not get anything going and the offense stalled as a whole in the second half. The Ravens will take on the Bills in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Bengals D/ST allows 13 points in Week 7 win
items.desc: The Bengals D/ST allowed 298 passing yards, 83 rushing yards, and 13 points in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: The Bengals' defense tallied four sacks and one interception in the win over Tyler Huntley and the Ravens. They will have a plus matchup against the Titans in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 7 win
items.desc: Evan McPherson connected on all five of his extra point attempts in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: McPherson was not asked to attempt a field goal, but was perfect after all five Bengals' touchdowns. The 27-year-old kicker has yet to miss an attempt this season an will look to continue that in Week 7 against the Titans.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Drew Sample hauls in touchdown in Week 7 win
items.desc: Drew Sample caught both of his targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Sample put the finishing touches on the Ravens with a late fourth quarter touchdown reception. This marked his first touchdown reception of the season. With his limited production, fantasy managers can leave him on the waiver wire.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mike Gesicki hits pay dirt in Week 7
items.desc: Mike Gesicki caught his lone target for six yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Gesicki found the end zone in the third quarter to open the scoring for the Bengals on their way to a comeback win. The veteran tight end has five touchdowns in six games so far this season. Gesicki and the Bengals will take on the Titans in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tee Higgins accounts for 148 yards in Week 7 win
items.desc: Tee Higgins caught 6-of-7 targets for 148 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Higgins gave the Bengals the lead in the third quarter on a 13-yard touchdown reception. This was a much needed bounce back performance after struggling in Week 5 against Miami. Higgins will look to build on this performance in Week 8 against the Titans.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase hits pay dirt in Week 7 win
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase caught 5-of-7 targets for 62 yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Chase found the end zone on a two-yard reception in the fourth quarter to extend the Bengals' lead. Chase has found the endzone in four out of six games so far this season. The star wide receiver will look to continue his strong play in Week 8 against the Titans.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Samaje Perine finds the end zone in Week 7 win
items.desc: Samaje Perine rushed for 16 yards and a touchdown on four carries in a 35-13 2in over the Ravens.
items.impact: Perine plunged into the end zone on a one-yard rush early in the fourth quarter to extend the Bengals' lead. The veteran continues to see limited work and can remain off fantasy managers' radar for now.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chase Brown sees 15 touches in Week 7 win
items.desc: Chase Brown rushed for 39 yards on 11 carries in a 35-13 win over the Ravens. He caught 4-of-5 passes for 19 yards.
items.impact: Brown continues to struggle in the running game and saw Samaje Perine get the goal line carry that resulted in the Bengals' lone rushing touchdown. Brown has not eclipsed 50 rushing yards since Week 3 and has failed to find the end zone since Week 1. Brown and the Bengals will take on the Titans in Week 8.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. tosses three touchdowns in win over 49ers
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. completed 25 of 34 passes for 213 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
items.impact: Penix made himself quite comfortable in this impressive performance, avoiding any sacks and committing no turnovers. Penix had just one three-touchdown game in his career before last week. He has now thrown three in each of the last two games without an interception. The 26-year-old QB has settled in at the helm of the Falcons' offense and is climbing the fantasy ranks.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Joe Burrow tosses four touchdowns in Week 7 win
items.desc: Joe Burrow completed 22-of-30 passes for 292 yards and four touchdowns in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens. He rushed for 12 yards on two carries.
items.impact: Burrow and the Bengals' offense came alive in the second half, erasing a 13-0 deficit with a 35 point performance to close out the comeback win. Burrow has eight touchdown passes in his last two games and will look to continue his recent strong play against the Titans in Week 8.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Bijan Robinson gains 122 yards of total offense in Week 7 win
items.desc: Bijan Robinson rushed for 63 yards on 20 carries and caught all five of his targets for 59 yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
items.impact: Robinson finished with just over 60 yards on the ground for the second straight week, but he nearly doubled his offensive output with his efforts in the passing game. Robinson hasn't visited the end zone since Week 4, and fantasy managers hope that will change in a Week 8 matchup with the Buccaneers. Robinson remains one of the top overall fantasy assets despite this short dry spell.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Drake London hauls in a touchdown during Week 7 win
items.desc: Drake London caught 7-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
items.impact: London finally hit paydirt this season. He's having a great season, but the end zone had simply eluded the fifth-year star over the first six weeks of the campaign. That changed in the fourth quarter of Sunday's upset of the 49ers. London is now averaging 5.4 receptions and 88 yards per game. He is a certain WR1 for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jahan Dotson catches one short pass in Sunday's win
items.desc: Jahan Dotson caught 1-of-3 targets for only six yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
items.impact: Dotson has become a big-play wideout for the Falcons, as he had averaged nearly 28 yards on his seven total grabs over the previous three weeks headed into Sunday's game. He had also found the end zone twice in that stretch. However, as should be expected going forward, Dotson showed in this contest that he is a boom-or-bust fantasy option in the Falcons' passing attack.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. hits paydirt again in Week 7 win
items.desc: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauled in all five of his targets for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
items.impact: For those who were patient with Pitts after a very slow start this season, the rewards have come over the last three weeks. The towering tight end has now scored four times during that span, catching exactly five passes each time out.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Nick Muse scores first career touchdown in Week 7 win
items.desc: Nick Muse caught two passes for two yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
items.impact: Muse is largely used on special teams by the Falcons, but he caught his first career touchdown pass on a goal-line play in the second quarter of Sunday's win. It was a nice moment for Muse, but he is nowhere near fantasy relevance.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Eddy Pineiro contributes just two points in Sunday's loss
items.desc: Eddy Pineiro did not attempt a field goal and made 2-of-3 PATs in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: Pineiro missed another PAT on Sunday, and he's now 21 of 25 on the season. He's also just 6-of-9 on FG attempts. Pineiro should be a solid fantasy option with the 49ers' potent offense, but he's been shaky at best.
